_comment: Daily blessing line sent together with the date sticker. Copy to messages.json (this file is gitignored as runtime config). Re-read from disk on every send. Manage from QQ (bot admin, private chat): dateimg.msg list | add <句子> | del <序号> | on | off | prefix <文字> | lead <文字>.
sentences: <一句祝福，例如：今天也是元气满满的一天喵~>
<可以放很多条，每天每个群随机抽一条>

_field_help.enabled: master on/off for the blessing line
_field_help.prefix: text line shown before the image (set '' to omit)
_field_help.lead: text prepended to the random sentence; default empty because no single lead-in fits every sentence
_field_help.sentences: pool of blessing lines; one is chosen at random per group per day
